_comment: What probe.py / apihunt.py actually proved, per source. Verified 2026-09-19. 'kind' decides the work: json/firestore need no LLM and no date parsing; html needs an extraction schema plus Czech date support.

aggregators.name: praguerocks
aggregators.auth: none — open read rules, no API key needed
aggregators.note: Thin: no start time, no description. Unblocks Palac Akropolis (site returns HTTP 204) and Lucerna (dates only in markup). YYYYMMDD is already handled by marseille's _COMPACT regex — zero date work.

aggregators.name: prague.eu
aggregators.upcoming: 628 date strings in visible text, 2.3 MB/page
aggregators.note: Official city agenda, city-wide (culture/exhibitions), complements praguerocks' rock focus. Needs an extraction schema + the Czech date regex.

aggregators.name: pragueexperience
aggregators.upcoming: 61 English date strings on the current month
aggregators.note: English listing: '16 September 2026' parses with marseille's dates.py UNCHANGED (_MONTHS already holds English names, _SINGLE already matches D Month YYYY). Cheapest source to add — no Czech work, and the extractor prompts need no translation either.

venues.name: Eternia Smichov
venues.images: none — the API has no image field and the site renders no event pictures. All 466 links are Facebook event URLs, and Facebook returns 400 to anonymous clients. Flyers exist only at instagram.com/eternia.smichov and facebook.com/eterniasmichov, so images need Apify + a vision model (marseille's social pipeline).
venues.note: Next.js static export, empty pageProps, data fetched client-side. Found by apihunt.py via an absolute URL to api.<venue>.com. Returns full history since 2019 — filter on datum, as the site's own JS does.

venues.name: Ceska filharmonie
venues.note: schema.org JSON-LD, 20 dated events + datetime attrs

venues.name: GoOut Praha
venues.note: schema.org JSON-LD, 9 on page 1 — aggregator, check its own API before scraping

venues.name: Rock Cafe
venues.note: server-rendered, 95 dates in text. /en/program/ is the same content. Also in praguerocks (51 events).

venues.name: DOX
venues.note: 50 dates in text. Serves 164 bytes to a Chrome UA and 141 kB to an honest one — do not spoof.

venues.name: Cross Club
venues.note: 21 dates in text; also in praguerocks

venues.name: Forum Karlin
venues.note: 31 dates in text; in praguerocks places but 0 upcoming there

venues.name: Palac Akropolis
venues.note: HTTP 204 No Content to everything including plain curl — a browser gets the same 204. Wrong URL, not a rendering problem. Use praguerocks (18 upcoming) until the real agenda URL is found.

venues.name: Divadlo Archa
venues.note: 29 kB server-rendered, zero dates anywhere in the raw HTML. Only remaining candidate that might genuinely need rendering.

_date_formats_seen.D. M. YYYY: Eternia datum, and the dominant Czech web format — needs a new regex in dates.py
_date_formats_seen.czech month names: rare: 20 hits across 12 venues, all on one site
